paper_title: Can Language Models Follow Multiple Turns of Entangled Instructions

model_annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of 1.1K samples across nine capabilities, categorized into four groups. The chart is divided into nine slices, each labeled with a distinct capability, including Context Tracking (dark blue), Recursive Reasoning (blue), Triggering (light blue), Dynamic Environment (navy blue), Memorization (blue-green), Dynamic Instruction (light teal), Context Retrieving (green), Multitasking (teal), and Privacy Protection (reddish-pink), and Contradiction Resolution (reddish-brown). The approximate proportions of the slices are: Context Tracking (14%), Recursive Reasoning (13%), Triggering (12%), Dynamic Environment (12%), Memorization (12%), Dynamic Instruction (12%), Context Retrieving (12%), Multitasking (19%), Privacy Protection (13%), and Contradiction Resolution (13%). The numbers associated with each slice are: Triggering (100), Recursive Reasoning (110), Dynamic Environment (100), Memorization (100), Dynamic Instruction (100), Context Retrieving (no number shown), Multitasking (160), Privacy Protection (111), and Contradiction Resolution (no number directly shown but is similar in size to others). The chart does not include a traditional legend, as the labels are directly connected to their respective slices. The slices are visually balanced, with some having similar sizes, and are ordered in a clockwise direction without a clear pattern of ascending or descending size.
